annotations.identity_signing_instant: signedAt 1788363959 (2026-09-02T15:45:59.000Z) — package metadata, OUTSIDE the signed bytes; the signed executedAt reads 1788363959 (2026-09-02T15:45:59.000Z)
annotations.identity_key_window: inside — evaluated at 1788361990 (2026-09-02T15:13:10.000Z) against key insight-oracle-safety-v2-202609 [validFrom 1787765736 (2026-08-26T17:35:36.000Z), validUntil open]
annotations.precedence: signed_before_block (asserted by signer, unanchored) — preTradeSignedAt 1788363929 is 30s before executedAt 1788363959. Ordering itself is not_checked: that a gate existed BEFORE the trade cannot be established from these bytes. Signature timestamps are package metadata and `checkedAt` is a signed field the signer chooses. Anchoring the gate uid before the trade transaction is what would close it.
annotations.observations: not_checked — participantCount, sourceGroupCount, independenceSatisfied, the consensus price's provenance and mevRiskBps are issuer claims; nothing in these bytes tests them.
